en-US.description:
FamilyPlate helps busy households turn pantry staples into practical dinner plans.

Scan groceries, track pantry items, save favorite recipes, and build grocery lists from the ingredients you are missing. When you want dinner ideas, FamilyPlate can use your pantry, preferences, and recipe history to suggest meals that fit what is already in your kitchen.

Features:

- Pantry tracking for ingredients you already have
- Camera and barcode scanning for faster grocery entry
- AI dinner ideas based on pantry items and household preferences
- Weekly meal planning for family dinners
- Saved cookbook recipes with ingredients and instructions
- Grocery list tools for missing recipe ingredients
- Account deletion, privacy, support, and terms links in Settings

FamilyPlate is not medical advice. Always verify ingredient labels, allergy information, and nutrition details yourself, especially for medical diets, allergies, or food restrictions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
FamilyPlate Terms: https://familyplate.co/terms
Privacy Policy: https://familyplate.co/privacy
en-US.releaseNotes:
FamilyPlate now estimates pantry expiration dates automatically.

- Estimate expiration dates from each pantry item's name, category, and storage location.
- Label estimated versus manual expiration dates directly in Pantry.
- Surface expired and expiring-soon pantry items faster so households know what to cook first.

review.notes:
FamilyPlate is an AI meal planning app for households. Reviewers can test pantry tracking, grocery list management, Cookbook, custom family recipes, Recently Cooked, Cook Again planning, Tonight suggestions, shop-first dinner suggestions, Weekly Plan, camera grocery scanning, barcode scanning, and App Store subscriptions.

Demo account:
Email: app-review@familyplate.co
Password: FamilyPlateReview!2026

The demo account is already onboarded with an App Review Household and lands in the main app after sign-in.

Subscriptions are available in Settings > Plan Usage. The app offers Monthly and Annual Family Plan subscriptions through Apple in-app purchase only; no external checkout links are used in the iOS app. Use Restore Purchases from the same section to verify subscription recovery.

AI features show a consent prompt before sending app data to third-party AI providers. Meal planning and photo recognition may send pantry items, grocery photos, household preferences, dietary notes, allergies, and recipe requests to OpenAI for app functionality.

The App Store description includes the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Functional Privacy Policy and FamilyPlate Terms links are also available in the app under Settings > Privacy & Account.
